QA RESULT · CHECKED IN THE RENDERED PNG
Inter and Noto Sans Arabic loaded from the bundled local TTF files; local font face vs Arial produced a different raster result.
Arabic joins and shaping are visible at 32 / 20 / 16 / 13 px. No disconnected or missing glyph was observed in these specimens.
Mixed-script direction, line metrics, actual Chromium rendering and native Arabic-reader acceptance are NOT validated by this static image.
Sources and versions: included Inter 4.1 / Noto Sans Arabic 2.012 variable fonts; accompanying OFL notices are preserved in fonts/.
